_comment3: Workspace file wins on any key present in both files.

skill_stats._write_approval: off | approve — when 'approve', autonomous skill rewrites are staged for review (pending_review tool / `nano-hermes pending`) instead of committed
skill_stats._ratchet: Contribution-score retirement + cap enforcement. Zero LLM calls. Enable once skills have >=100 uses.
skill_stats._skill_designer: Proposes new skills for tasks where no skill was used and outcome was fail/partial.
skill_stats._cheatsheet: Extracts one transferable lesson per session; retrieved at iteration 0.
skill_stats._opro: Evolves internal evolution prompts via LLM-as-optimizer. Fires every N evolution cycles.

principles._write_approval: off | approve — stage curator principle edits for review instead of applying

_expel: ExpeL contrastive insight extraction. Pairs sessions with opposite outcomes; one LLM call extracts insight.
_decay_trust: Auto trust-scoring of injected cheatsheet/expel lessons. Trust moves by session outcome; retrieval ranks by distance/trust and hides facts below the floor. Inert unless cheatsheet/expel on.
